I may summarize many of our field-work as the following "How do we Human beings actually function?"

Many of the problems we face today, may be attributed to a lack of understanding; whether it is our responsibility, or the systems we are embedded in, who's reponsibility are the authors of those systems. 

Rather than precise neuroscience, or vague philosophy, we unify these distant Domains "How do we actually learn? How does a Human being confront events of suffering? How far can cognition and intellect ..."

Amongst these... is the internal commentary
